resources.string: Read air pressure and estimate altitude using an explicit reference.
This device has no pressure sensor. No network or location fallback is used.
The pressure sensor could not be started.
Waiting for a valid pressure reading (100–1200 hPa)…
1013.25 hPa is the standard-atmosphere default, NOT current weather. Enter a known reference if available; no weather or location is fetched.
Enter 800–1100 using a decimal point and at most two decimal places, without leading zeros.

Standard-atmosphere estimate, not GPS altitude or guaranteed true elevation. Weather, reference pressure and sensor error affect it. Negative estimates are possible. Not for navigation, aviation, or safety-critical use.
Foreground sensor readings and reference are transient. No permissions, location, network, saved results, or measurement history.
Open the tool to read pressure. Keep the standard reference or enter a known sea-level pressure between 800 and 1100 hPa. The estimate updates from valid sensor readings.
At 1013.25 hPa with a 1013.25 hPa reference, the pressure-altitude estimate is zero.
Requires a pressure sensor. Standard-atmosphere approximation only, not measured true elevation. No automatic weather correction.
